question.text: Technical analysis of equity shares involves:

answer.text: Studying price and volume patterns to understand buying and selling interest, using historical data and chart patterns
Analyzing the company's balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and cash flow
Evaluating the credit rating of the company's debt instruments
Calculating the net asset value of a mutual fund scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Technical analysis studies price and volume patterns to understand how buyers and sellers are acting on existing information. It uses historical price and volume charts, identifies points of support and resistance, price trends, and indicators of buying and selling interest. The Trap: Analyzing financial statements (option B) is fundamental analysis. Credit-rating evaluation (option C) is debt analysis. NAV calculation (option D) is mutual fund valuation. Note: Technical analysis treats price as the aggregate indicator of available information; it does not evaluate the underlying business fundamentals directly.
